note: 0.2.4 combat skills. Weapon class (items.json gear.class) decides the skill needed to wield it, the default style and the swing speed. Armour (head/body/legs/shield) needs Defence. Accuracy = 0.55 + (Attack + gear atk) x 1% - enemy defence x (1 - armour_break) x 2% (10-95%). Max hit = 1 + Strength/6 + weapon power + gear str/4. Enemy accuracy = base - (gear def x 1% + Defence x defence_level_acc) (5-95%).
note_combat_level: 0.3.1 combat level (Combat.combat_level) = floor((Attack + Strength + Defence + Vitality) / 4 + Prayer / 8), min 1; a new character is Combat 3. Enemies never START a fight with a player or AI player whose combat level is aggro_level_gap or more above the enemy's level (they still fight back when attacked). Applies everywhere, the Scorch included.
